modules.module_title: Preparing for the service and repair

pcs.pc_description: review troubleshooting instructions sheets
select relevant tools, 100% approved and verified field replaceable part as per SOP
inspect electrical connections, circuits, terminals and earthing to avoid electrical shock
inspect entire battery system / battery pack for various defects
inspect battery monitoring integrated circuit (IC) for proper functioning
inspect passive cell balancing up to 1.3 A per cell and voltage of single cell (O.1 - 5.0 V, resolution 1 MV)
measure single cell internal resistance for implementing under / over voltage protection
decide the replacement or repair of modules on field or at the company’s workshop

modules.module_title: Repairing or replacing faulty parts after diagnosis

pcs.pc_description: apply the required current of the controller for measuring voltage of each cell
practice isolation of the battery pack between current and charger for estimating state of charge (SOC)
practice connection of the battery system with positive and negative cells
perform fixing of common problems faced with ICs, MOSFAT, plugs and wiring of the devices
disassemble and re-assemble the system for removal and replacement of any faulty parts
communicate with technical helpdesk to seek any assistance at site
conclude the task as per standard operating procedure and quality benchmark of the company
inform customer about the service / repairing activity been undertaken
instruct customer on procedures to be followed for operating the battery
inform on the workload and completion status
report work status through proper documentation as per organizational standards
intimate about the problem that cannot be resolved at field with reasons
report 100% on time completion of service, repair or part replacement with reference to agreed target and time or reasons for not meeting target
prepare the feedback form on customer satisfaction level
